content: npm trusted publishing via OIDC is GA (since mid-2025). Configure trusted publisher on npmjs.com (org/repo/workflow file/environment); workflow needs permissions id-token: write; requires npm CLI >= 11.5.1 (Node 24 runners fine). With OIDC, provenance attestations are published by default, --provenance flag not needed, no NPM_TOKEN secret. Works with changesets/action + changeset publish. Provenance unavailable for private repos.
